subject: aftd
title: AFTD.------ACC.DY.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 448 (TRF(CW)-20). AFTD (affinity tendencies) is the subject; ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-CY, PART (participation) and ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From INFO-CY: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics). From IF-ST-DY: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From PART: POL-DY (political dynamics). From POL-DY: EXT-CONT-2. From ALT-F: C-INFO (composite information). From C-INFO: ATTN (attraction). From ATTN: APP-DT.
